svg.title: Study area: Willamette and Umpqua River basins, Oregon
svg.desc: Map of western Oregon showing the Willamette River basin in the north and the Umpqua River basin in the south, including its North Umpqua, South Umpqua, and mainstem Umpqua subbasins, based on USGS Watershed Boundary Dataset HUC6/HUC8 boundaries. A shaded circle over the Umpqua basin marks a generalized, approximate focal sampling area; no exact coordinates are shown.
